description: The agent-host side of the Miadi Factory. Its center is the chronicle-episode skill: minting, registering, relating and closing Miadi Chronicle episodes, with their ceremonies, talking circles and reviews. Around it: Claude Code plugins for session capture and restore, witnessing, companions and screenwalk media, host-neutral skills, hooks, and apt packages that install the chronicle's commands on a machine.
rules: Create a Chronicle episode with mkepisode or the episode API (POST /api/chronicle/episodes), never with mkdir under MIADI_CHRONICLE_ROOT.
Report an episode at the last stage proven (created, committed, pushed, registered, receipt-verified), each with its own probe.
Reach the chronicle wheel through MIADI_CHRONICLE_MW_URL and the app through MIADI_API_URL; never hardcode a wheel URL.
Resolve exact @miadi/* versions and CLI flags from the npm registry or https://docs.miadi.jgwill.com/packages/llms.txt, not from a kit prompt.
